notes.title: Big update from Luden.io
notes.notes:
Hello all :) Oleg from Luden.io is here. I can't wait to tell you that today our new game Learning Factory finally becomes available. We'll be super happy if you stop by and join us on this adventure of [url=https://blog.luden.io/meet-learning-factory-8d5fd27dac7e]making the best educational game we can[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

Please don't hesitate to drop me a line in [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] or privately via oleg.chumakov@luden.io. I am always happy to talk :)

notes.title: A huge update coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28302138/fc01fe3a8809de7dc16b40c6cc3d81df9aefd25b.jpg[/img]

Friends, we are happy to tell you that the global changes in the game are getting closer and closer!

Now we are testing VRobot in 4 hands, guess why?ːsmileː

That's right, we managed to get through the difficulties of making the multiplayer mode! You will be able to fight 1x1 with an opponent, using improvised means - at home, in a car, - very soon.

I will tell you even more: in this mode you will see a new system of movement - locomotion, - which you asked us to make in the comments for a lot of times. The old maps will still have a "teleport" functioning on them.

Also, we have prepared a new map specifically for the multiplayer mode.

Next time I will definitely tell you more about the new map, and also show how your VRobot will look in the game!

What kinds of weapons would you like to see in the new mode? Do not hesitate to write in the comments down below, we always do appreciate your opinion.

notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jCF0QTyXhlHvsA/giphy.gif[/img]

The robots have studied the mankind archives for a long time and managed to learn that a portal of evil spirits will open on the last night of October. In order to prevent the catastrophe, they've replaced all the buildings in the city and their own robo-heads... with pumpkins. 

While seeds are inside of their heads instead of microcircuits, you can take an advantage of the situation and hit them in the "pumpkins".
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J9KSMyZgJWs56yk/giphy.gif[/img]

Hurry up! When the portal is closed, everything will get back to normal.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohhwGBJDlZiVmPmco/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1] You can purchase the game with -40% discount during the week! [/h1]

notes.title: Horror update soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohhwmwlkXgapaSXIs/giphy.gif[/img]
Hello, friends!

The most sinister and creepy holiday is coming to the town - and it's Halloween!

No chance in hell we are missing this holiday! Unfortunately, it is very hard to find a pumpkin in Russia this time of the year, and the hands of our designers and programmers are used to keyboards, not knives. So, it is easier for us to "code" a pumpkin, ehehːsteammockingː

Soon we will bring you a nice update, but until then - prepare your Jack-o'-lanterns!

[i]Trick or treat![/i]

notes.title: Update is coming
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohhwHBEks0oTUfdUk/giphy.gif[/img] 

Hello dear friends! I have some secret information for you to tell. It's all about VRobot update :) So our game designer can't play VR anymore because he spent 2 weeks inside, but fine-tuning is finally done. So we preparing:

[list]
    [*]Big AI update. I can bet you'll unable to catch Robocitizen so easy as before.
    [*]New awesome weapon. Only thing can say that it is mindblowing.
    [*]Big physics update. Even Robocitizens are now real calculated.
[/list]

Stay tuned, it'll be released very soon :)
